purpose: Evaluate an explicit first-person self-sponsorship veto, alongside the upstream 0.7 threshold, without selecting passages before inference
scope: Development tune only; candidate conceived after qualitative tune inspection, so channel folds are diagnostic and fresh unseen test is mandatory
veto: An affirmative first-person self-sponsored clause in complete cues wholly contained in a predicted span. Quoted clauses ignored. Explicit third-party sponsorship attribution within that span preserves the suggestion. No creator, brand, timestamp, duration or reference-label rules.
inference: Hash-verified existing browser logits only; no Node or cloud model inference
selection: Same conservative selection and promotion gates as registered overlap study; no changing disputed or unknown labels
freshTest: No production promotion until fresh independent evaluation and reviewed negative exposure
frozenBenchmark: Original pilot, frozen config, adapters, evaluator and exposed test ledger remain unchanged
